description.text: Applicants for Preparatory Program don’t need to take Entrance Examination. Students who study Preparatory Program in BUCM and pass their Program Examination can enroll directly into Undergraduate Program

duration.text: The Preparatory Undergraduate Training at Beijing University of Chinese Medicine is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per semester ￥ 14000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of highest education 5.Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear).

requirements.text: 1.High school graduate or equivalent or above. 2.Applicants must be in good health 3.Good command of Chinese(Reading, oral, aural and written)
